note: The session's shared web-search allowance was already used up when this part began, so research went only through pages that could be reached directly (party candidate lists already gathered, county, city and school district sites). Many county and city sites did not resolve, refused the kit's fetcher (Louisville Metro's site answers 403; the Prosecutors Advisory Council's directory sits behind a login, not attempted) or draw their member lists by script (Franklin County Schools), so 25 of the 30 candidates are left blank. Daniel Konstantopoulos is listed (not endorsed) on the Republican Party of Kentucky's candidates page, already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json; that page links his campaign site. For a person to look at, not a review item (no official source was read): our record marks every Louisville/Jefferson County Metro Council and mayor contest 'Nonpartisan office', while the Jefferson County Republican Party's 2026 candidates page lists Metro Council candidates by district as Republicans (https://louisvillegop.com/2026republicancandidates/) and Wikipedia's members table gives each member a party. Verifier: the Jefferson District Court Judges page lists Judge Tanisha A. Hickerson in Division 07, while the race she is filed in is Division 9; the office (a sitting Jefferson District Court judge) is kept, the division difference is for a person to look at.
